# Fenre fixtures

Verbatim copies of upstream files from
<https://github.com/fenre/splunk-monitoring-use-cases> at commit
`3b8024a8cf2e31c2fc02e16fd2fb39d43f931828` (VERSION 8.28.0, schema 1.11.0),

Malformed or adversarial records are generated in the tests, not stored here.
